lines.text: I’ve been knocked down harder than I thought I’d ever be
But I’m still here breathing, still wearing this heart on my sleeve
The scars are real, the lessons cut deep
But I’m learning how to stand without losing sleep
I don’t have to be unbreakable to be strong
I just have to keep going when everything feels wrong
I’m still standing, still singing, still showing up
Still believing there’s beauty in the way we love
I’m not the same girl who used to break so easily
I’m still standing — and I’m proud of me
I used to think that falling meant that I had failed
Now I know the getting up is where the real story’s told
Every time I chose myself when it would’ve been easier to stay
I built a little more of the woman I’m becoming today
I don’t have to be unbreakable to be strong
I just have to keep going when everything feels wrong
I’m still standing, still singing, still showing up
Still believing there’s beauty in the way we love
I’m not the same girl who used to break so easily
I’m still standing — and I’m proud of me
I’m not perfect, I’m not done, I’m still figuring it out
But I’m standing here with open hands and an open heart
I’m still standing, still singing, still showing up
Still believing there’s beauty in the way we love
I’m not the same girl — I’m better than I used to be
I’m still standing — and I’m proud of me
